scope: Conditional consequences of the user's cumulative time-stretch postulate, with mandatory transfer of lost photon energy to companions. Not a derived fundamental field theory or an observational validation.
agreed_rules: Stretch accumulates during propagation; ordinary static gravitational time dilation is not the proposed cause.
Every unit of photon energy lost through this process enters the companion/graviton sector at conversion.
Companions may accompany light or follow other paths. Capture transfers, rather than creates, energy.
candidate_closure: The entire signal, including carrier cycles and event-feature spacing, acquires the same local fractional stretch d(log S)/ds=alpha(s). This is an explicit candidate closure to test, not a consequence of energy bookkeeping alone.
assumptions_for_predictions: Identical calibrated source and receiver clock/energy standards
Deterministic achromatic stretch approximately constant across each event
Fixed Euclidean source-detector geometry for flux ratios; no extra absorption or focusing
constructive_ray_example: In reference c=1 units take omega=k/n(x,t), n=1+alpha*g(x)*t, g=sin(pi*x/L)^2 on a void slab. Integrate Hamiltonian rays through both boundaries with n=1 there. This is an optional effective propagation-clock realization, not an adopted matter/gravity action.
checks: Hamiltonian frequency change and finite arrival-time separation independently agree with exp(alpha*L/2)
Accumulated companion energy equals photon loss
Both endpoints have n=1; clock-standard changes at endpoints do not manufacture this example's redshift
Two successive affine signal maps compose with multiplicative stretch and correctly transformed delay
Integrating a stretched pulse verifies photon count, energy, duration and power factors
Constant-rate capture ODE conserves photon+companion+deposit energy in an optional no-loss/permanent-deposit limit
rate_illustrations: Reuse the historical conversion-first fitted effective alpha only to illustrate distance dependence. It is not a fit of a void-specific coupling; billions-of-light-years examples extrapolate beyond the original 10-93 Mpc sample.
physical_completion_requirements: Derive the time/companion-field action and alpha's environmental dependence
Show the prescribed propagation-clock profile follows with backreaction rather than imposing it for free
Conserve momentum and derive companion propagation, including whether the time-stretch coupling also affects companions
Explain source/detector clock standards and matter coupling without arbitrary exemptions
Derive capture, supported storage and a joint motion/lensing response
receiver_status: The companion sector is the agreed energy receiver. Do not reopen receiver selection; test whether proposed equations implement the agreed transfer.
